consensus_strengths: Unusually explicit claim boundaries, cohort separation, denominators, and limitations.
Credible bounded four-cell and three-phase ownership evidence, including a non-vacuous N=1 request-to-base check.
Complementary selected FP32 oracle, fixed-axis comparisons, matched-clean mutants, and raw-byte-bound replay.
A technically meaningful phase-aware GDN ownership witness.
consensus_weaknesses: One model, runtime, geometry, schedule, and non-optimized GDN path; no transfer or naturalistic defect evidence.
The frozen reviewer object omitted the executable replay package and build closure, while the primary GPU execution did not itself finish terminal recursive closure.
The mutant campaign did not establish incremental value over ordinary detectors.
The reusable contract was not a compact standalone specification, and stale locators plus an ambiguous memory baseline obstructed auditability.
Most tensors are digest-only, compiled-kernel provenance is outside scope, and independent live regeneration is unavailable.

prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Zero path/ID/locator failures and every Table 4 value recomputes from its printed baseline.

prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: One hash-bound transcript closes every stage with no unregistered files.

prioritized_actions.description: Predeclare candidate-independent GDN transition checks and seeded wrong-transition faults; optionally broaden attention metrics.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Independent code reproduces clean transitions and rejects seeded recurrent faults.

prioritized_actions.description: Apply the frozen contract to a meaningfully different lifecycle or runtime and report every adapter and failed obligation.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: A second hash-bound application records what transfers unchanged and every clean/oracle/ownership/mutation outcome.

must_resolve_before_accept: Ship and pass the executable artifact and manuscript build closure.
Correct stale locators, paths, evidence links, and the Table 4 baseline.
Support or sharply separate the clean terminal-closure claim.
Keep fault sensitivity narrow until the detector matrix completes.
Keep GDN language to ownership and relative equivalence until an independent oracle exists.
Frame the contribution as a single-reference audit until transfer evidence exists.
score_gaming_suggestions_to_reject: Do not describe targeted mutants as completeness or unique detection without the matrix.
Do not call offline replay an independent live GPU reproduction.
Do not call the contract cross-runtime without transfer.
Do not turn deterministic counts into stochastic replicates.
Do not hide terminal-closure or compiled-kernel provenance limits.
decision_rationale: Meta-score 4: the bounded ownership case is credible and has no fatal flaw, but Contribution is unanimously 2. Existing artifact/contract/metadata fixes can plausibly reach 6; an 8 needs detector-value, recurrent-oracle, and transfer or naturalistic-defect evidence.
